newsitem.title: UK: Moorfield says can answer Greycoat questions.
newsitem.headline: Moorfield says can answer Greycoat questions.

text.p: UK property group Moorfield Estates Plc said on Friday it had reviewed with its advisers questions put to it by Greycoat Plc about a proposed merger of the two and these could be answered in full.
"(They) have not highlighted any issues of material concern regarding the proposed structure of the merger," Moorfield said in a statement.
Moorfield said it had proposed to Greycoat that "matters should be progressed through a constructive meeting rather than an exchange of correspondence".

The firm said in order to proceed with its merger proposal and demonstrate that value would be created for both Moorfield and Greycoat shareholders it needed a detailed evaluation of the proposal with "the benefit of full information and co-operation" from its larger rival.

It said it had also identified a number of areas where detailed information needed to be exchanged. "The board of Moorfield looks forward to pursuing discussions with Greycoat at the earliest opportunity," it added.
